# Stacks source fixture

Source attribution: The Stacks Project Authors. The section text is an exact
excerpt of topology.tex at Git revision
`a04446e57ec1fbc252a871afcec7752fb2807b14`, from
https://github.com/stacks/stacks-project. The file contains original lines 1–190
followed by an added end-of-document boundary for bounded tests. The selected
08ZD statements and proofs are unchanged. The tag map is filtered from the same
revision to the labels in the excerpt. The preamble and COPYING are verbatim
from that revision. See COPYING for the GNU Free Documentation License.

These are derivative test fixtures, not full upstream files. Transport doubles
use an explicitly synthetic Git revision; actual-host import downloads complete
files from the official repository at one real commit. No mathematical checking
or authorship by the tester is asserted.
